description: This file defines the DefaultTimesheetAPI class in the OrangeHRM Time plugin. It provides an API endpoint to retrieve default timesheet data for a given employee and date range. The class handles request parameters, interacts with the timesheet service for data retrieval, and returns timesheet models in a standardized API response.

classes.name: DefaultTimesheetAPI
classes.description: An API endpoint for retrieving default timesheet data based on employee number and date range.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Handles GET request to fetch default timesheet based on query parameters 'date' and 'empNumber'. It interacts with the timesheet service to retrieve or initialize a timesheet object and returns it wrapped in a resource result.

methods.name: getDate
methods.description: Retrieves the 'date' query parameter as a DateTime object, or null if not provided.

methods.name: getEmpNumberParamRule
methods.description: Defines validation rule for 'empNumber' parameter, marking it as not required.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Returns validation rules for the 'getOne' method, including optional date format and employee number validation.
